content: LLM usage tracker feature set (2026): CodexBar (19.8k stars) — 69 providers, per-provider usage meters with reset countdowns, session/weekly/monthly windows, credit balances, spend charts, status polling with incident badges, merge-icons mode, adaptive refresh default 5min with 1/2/5/15/30 fixed, WidgetKit widgets, optional quota notifications, weekly-reset confetti. TokenBar (248 stars) — reads local session logs (same opencode.db approach), quota cards with pace projections, signal bars/ring/melting popsicle icon styles, stale-value persistence. minimax-usage-checker (project's inspiration) — 30s refresh, color-coded progress (green<70% orange 70-90% red>90%), warning alert at 85% used / critical at 95%, dedup once per window, API exposes startTime/endTime/remainsTime per model window. onWatch — 60s polling daemon, SQLite snapshots, quota-exhaustion forecast, early-reset anomaly detection, email/push thresholds. denshub comparison (May 2026) rates CodexBar #1; warns TokenBar has scammy subscription cancellation.
